# Minutes: print run planning

## Decisions

- The Salt Road opens with 3,000 hardback copies; the paperback waits for winter sales. @00:30-01:00
- The book gets a sewn binding, 15 percent above a glued one. @05:00-06:00
- 500 more copies for the November fair, delivered together with the rest. @06:30-07:30

## Printer

- Szélmalom quoted 2.1 million forints, jacket and delivery included. @01:30-02:00
- Inside pages on 90 gram cream stock; the designer sees a sample sheet first. @02:30-03:30
- Stock in our storeroom by 20 October if the files leave at the end of September. @04:00-04:30
